decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line with high strategic fit, uncertainty remains but the option is worth keeping open.
The comfort insole is a low-cost adjacent option, and keeping it costs little while uncertainty about demand resolves.

The ergonomic safety shoe series has dedicated marketing and strong core fit, making its option value high enough to keep.
